title: Leak repair triage for scarce water
summary: Prioritizes leaks so stored water is not lost during outages or drought.
content: Leak repair triage for scarce water is a practical offline routine for leak control. Check storage containers, caps, taps, hoses, toilet tanks, roof tanks, and carrying containers on a schedule. Mark leaks as dripping, steady, spraying, structural, or unknown. Capture leaking water for non-drinking use if it has not touched contamination. Prioritize leaks threatening drinking water, medicine, baby care, or structural damage. Do only low-risk tightening or isolation; avoid pressurized, electrical, gas, or structural hazards.
steps: Mark leaks as dripping, steady, spraying, structural, or unknown.
